description: GRANT / REVOKE statement breadth: multi-privilege lists on a table, ALL / FUTURE tables in a schema, account-level privileges (ON ACCOUNT), role-to-user grants, OWNERSHIP transfer, and the matching REVOKEs, checked via SHOW GRANTS row counts. Converted 1:1 from security/GrantRevokeBreadthTest (now retired). Roles/users are account-level in the shared engine session, so each test creates them with OR REPLACE and drops them at the end.

steps.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE breadth_t TO ROLE breadth_role
REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE breadth_t FROM ROLE breadth_role
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA test_schema TO ROLE breadth_role
GRANT SELECT ON FUTURE TABLES IN SCHEMA test_schema TO ROLE breadth_role
GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON ACCOUNT TO ROLE breadth_role
GRANT ROLE breadth_role TO USER breadth_user
REVOKE ROLE breadth_role FROM USER breadth_user
REVOKE CREATE DATABASE ON ACCOUNT FROM ROLE breadth_role
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON TABLE breadth_t TO ROLE breadth_role
